channel.title: Japan AI Monitor
channel.description: AI monitoring of Japan's political, economic and security developments

item.title: Japan’s producer prices pick up, backing case for another BOJ rate hike
item.description: Prices for goods traded between Japanese firms climbed 0.7% month on month in October, the fastest since May.

item.title: First bird flu case of the season confirmed at Kyoto poultry farm
item.description: The potential spread of the avian flu could further raise egg prices ahead of high demand at the end of the year.

item.title: Nomura explores possible sale of Laser Digital crypto unit
item.description: Japan's largest securities firm is talking to potential buyers including Marex, which is evaluating the deal.

item.title: Yen nears key ¥160 level after U.S. inflation data, sparking intervention risk
item.description: The prospect of tightening by the U.S. Federal Reserve risks widening the U.S.-Japan rate differential and adding to downward pressure on the yen.

item.title: Swiss franc, Japanese yen Rise as DeepSeek News Boosts Safe Havens
item.description: The Yen and Swiss Franc were stronger against the dollar as investors sought safe havens after Chinese start-up DeepSeek’s new AI model hit U.S. tech stocks.
